page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 156 at top right. Main text in one column of verse, with a centred heading "Abrahamus. Angelus." and speaker names set as centred small capitals. Scattered marginal decoration only, no printed notes.

main_text.p:
Vernaq; Vilis turba, quae pascit pecus
Gregesque Abrami scilicet, repellere

Meos valebit impetus, & abditas
Cauere fraudes. Quicquid accidat, statim

Saxum monebo quodlibet tentans meis
Astutiores implicare cassibus.
main_text.head: Abrahamus. Angelus.
ABRAHAMVS.
main_text.p:
Quum pergat Sysque Caelitum mens prouida
Mihi fauere, seu minaces hostium

Fortis retundat impetus, seu copiam
Frugum quotannis largiatur, & pecus

Cornigerum adaugens, omnibus quotquot soli
Glebas Cananaei Someribus fulcant Jus,

Me ditiorem reddat, & (quod caeteris
Maius bonum cunctus puto seni datum)

Haeredem i facum fospitet, Six Six meam
Damnare possum pigritiam satis, Deo

Quod gratias subinde cesso reddere,
Ipsique laudes debitas persoluere.
main_text.head: ANGELVS.
main_text.p:
Abrame, Abrame, missus arce Olympica
Adsum supremi Regis ales nuntius,

Quae mandat, audi: protinus tardas procul
Moras repelle, & imperata fac lubens.

Assume mox tuum unicum natum, anxie
Amore quem senex pater complecteris,

page.notes: The page is a printed text page, but the scan is heavily stained and the verse lines are only partly legible; the lines are transcribed as best read. Ornamental marks and show-through in the margins are omitted. The line breaks of the verse are marked with line breaks inside paragraphs. Some Greek or abbreviation forms may be misread.
